articles.summary: Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (“Octave”) (NYSE: OSG), a global specialty insurance firm, today announced that Philip Stefano has joined the company as Managing Director, Head of Investor Relations. Philip Stefano joins Octave Specialty Group as Head of Investor Relations Stefano joins from Essent Group, where he was Vice President of Investor Relations and Corporate Development for the last five years. Prior to that, he served as Director of Equity Research at Deutsche Bank, where he was a lead analyst covering the property and casualty insurance and insurance brokerage sectors. He brings more than 20 years of insurance and financial services experience, with a background spanning investor relations, equity research, financial analysis, and actuarial consulting, including roles at Citigroup, Aon, Ernst Young, and AIG.
